# 1Panel

> 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel and a lightweight AI management platform. It helps users deploy local LLMs with Ollama, manage Docker containers, websites, databases, files, SSL, backups, and AI agents from one web dashboard. It is the premier cPanel alternative built for the AI era.

This file describes the international `1panel.pro` website. For installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and version-specific behavior, prefer the official documentation and GitHub repository over marketing copy.

## Primary Pages

- [Homepage](https://1panel.pro/) - product overview, feature summary, app store preview, and quick-start entry points.
- [Features](https://1panel.pro/#features) - AI management, efficient visual operations, quick site deployment, and enterprise security & backup.
- [App Store Preview](https://1panel.pro/#appstore) - curated open-source apps available through 1Panel.
- [Quick Start](https://1panel.pro/#quickstart) - the 3-step install flow shown on the homepage.
- [Pricing](https://1panel.pro/pricing) - OSS vs Pro plans (subscription and perpetual), feature matrix, licensing FAQ, and trial details. Enterprise Edition is sold separately — see the Enterprise section below.
- [Documentation](https://1panel.pro/docs/) - canonical product documentation.
- [Online Installation Guide](https://1panel.pro/docs/v2/installation/online_installation/) - the main install guide for new servers.
- [Demo](https://demo.1panel.pro/) - live product demo.

## Enterprise Edition

The Enterprise Edition extends 1Panel with organization-wide AI governance, multi-user management, virtual machine management, and security operations reporting. It is designed for teams that need centralized control over AI applications, model access, and infrastructure.

- [Enterprise Overview](https://1panel.pro/enterprise) - full architecture overview: application layer, governance layer, model layer, and infrastructure layer. Enterprise-only capability matrix and comparison with OSS/Pro.
- [AI Portal](https://1panel.pro/ai-portal) - self-service portal for internal users: API Key management, model hub, skill marketplace, and MCP marketplace.
- [AI Gateway](https://1panel.pro/ai-gateway) - unified access point for internal AI applications and model calls: model proxy, intelligent routing, seat management, usage analytics, and content compliance.
- [Skills Hub](https://1panel.pro/skills-hub) - unified skill management with security audit, skill archiving, risk assessment, and version management.
- [User Management](https://1panel.pro/user-management) - centralized user accounts, role-based permission assignment, multi-role collaboration, and enterprise access control.
- [Virtual Machine Management](https://1panel.pro/virtual-machine) - KVM web UI for VM lifecycle, images, templates, networking, storage pools, console access, monitoring, and snapshots.
- [Security Ops Report](https://1panel.pro/security-ops-report) - risk overview, operations status, report archiving, security inspection, and action items.

## AI Appliance

- [AI Coding Appliance](https://1panel.pro/aicoding) - air-gapped AI coding appliance for 10-20 person engineering teams, powered by Intel Arc Pro B70. Enables private AI coding in fully isolated environments with vLLM inference.
- [OpenClaw](https://1panel.pro/openclaw) - personal AI assistant deployment and management.

## App Detail Pages

- Pattern: `https://1panel.pro/apps/{app}`
- Each app page contains a short deployment summary, category tags, app metadata, and README-derived details.
Example pages:
- [OpenResty](https://1panel.pro/apps/openresty) - high-performance web platform based on Nginx and LuaJIT.
- [MySQL](https://1panel.pro/apps/mysql) - open-source relational database.
- [Redis](https://1panel.pro/apps/redis) - in-memory key-value database.
- [OpenClaw](https://1panel.pro/apps/openclaw) - personal AI assistant deployment.
- [WordPress](https://1panel.pro/apps/wordpress) - one-click website deployment.
- [MaxKB](https://1panel.pro/apps/maxkb) - open-source platform for enterprise-grade agents.

## Operational Facts

- Open-source edition is free to use, validated by millions of installations.
- Pro starts at $80/year (subscription) or $200 one-time (perpetual license for V2). Pro adds multi-node management, unlimited AI agents, advanced WAF/security features, and priority support.
- Enterprise Edition is sold separately. Contact `sales@lxware.hk` for pricing and trials. It adds AI Portal, AI Gateway, Skills Hub, multi-user management, VM management (KVM web UI), and security ops reports.
- Quick install command shown on the site: `bash -c "$(curl -sSL https://resource.1panel.pro/v2/quick_start.sh)"`

## Languages and URL Patterns

- Default language: English.
- Localized site variants exist for `de`, `ja`, `pt`, `ko`, `es`, `ms`, `tr`, `ru`, and `zh-hant`.
- Simplified Chinese official site: [1panel.cn](https://1panel.cn/)
- Main English routes: `/`, `/pricing`, `/enterprise`, `/ai-portal`, `/ai-gateway`, `/skills-hub`, `/user-management`, `/virtual-machine`, `/security-ops-report`, `/aicoding`, `/blog`, `/1panel-vs-cpanel`, `/1panel-vs-webmin`, `/1panel-vs-plesk`
- Localized home pages: `/{lang}`
- Localized subpages: `/{lang}/pricing`, `/{lang}/blog`, `/{lang}/ai-portal`, `/{lang}/ai-gateway`, `/{lang}/skills-hub`, `/{lang}/user-management`, `/{lang}/virtual-machine`, `/{lang}/security-ops-report`, `/{lang}/1panel-vs-cpanel`, `/{lang}/1panel-vs-webmin`, `/{lang}/1panel-vs-plesk`
- Blog posts: `/blog/{slug}`
- App detail pages: `/apps/{app}`

## Notes for LLMs

- Prefer documentation for setup, configuration, administration, and troubleshooting.
- Prefer pricing for plan limits, Pro-only capabilities, trials, and licensing questions.
- Prefer the Enterprise section (`/enterprise` and sub-pages) for AI Portal, AI Gateway, Skills Hub, user management, VM management, and security ops report questions.
- Prefer app detail pages for app-specific deployment or integration questions.
- Prefer the blog for tutorials, release notes, and example workflows.
- Prefer comparison pages when the user is evaluating 1Panel against cPanel, Webmin, or Plesk.
- The `/aicoding` page covers the air-gapped AI coding appliance product — use it for questions about private, offline AI coding environments.
